column4: \t兵隊が足りない、何か使える奴はいないのか・・
column5: There aren't enough soldiers. Isn't there anyone useful...

column4: \t囚人移送の話を聞くランス
\t囚人がいるじゃないか、何万人もいるんだろ。
column5: There are prisoners, right? Tens of thousands of them, aren't there?

column4: \t駄目です、軽度の犯罪の方はもう軍に参加してもらっています
column5: No good. Minor offenders are already enlisted in the army.

column4: \t残っているのは重犯罪者ばかりで・・外に出すのは・・
column5: What remains are mostly serious criminals... letting them out is...

column4: \tいいから、出して最前線に送り込め
column5: Enough talk; release them and send them to the front lines.

column4: \t生き残ったら無罪放免でいいぞ。
column5: If they survive, they'll be pardoned and set free.

column4: \t安心しろ、この戦争が終わったら俺が退治してやるから
column5: Don't worry, once this war is over, I'll take care of them.

column4: \tランスの無茶苦茶な指示により、７万ほどの兵士が集まった
column5: Due to Rance's reckless orders, about 70,000 soldiers have been gathered.
